description: List the active product in the bearer token's organization. Use this for setup and identity checks; use get_daily_pulse for the customer's current precomputed 24-hour snapshot. The current Founder plan supports one active product. Requires products:read or products:create; invalid or expired authority fails closed, and the shared MCP limit is 300 calls per 60 seconds per caller before HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
name: list_products

products.description: Active products visible to this authorization.

id.description: Stable product/property ID to pass as product_id to product-scoped tools.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone used for product-local daily metrics.

title: List analytics products
